description.narrative: The Sustainable Market for Inclusive Livelihoods (SMILE) project is implemented by Nyamahasa Area Cooperative Enterprise (ACE) in partnership with We Effect in the mid-western region of Uganda, an area that hosts significant refugee populations and offers highly fertile agricultural land. Despite this potential, farmers face substantial constraints including wildlife incursions from nearby conservation areas, climate variability, weak governance in cooperatives, poor post-harvest handling, and limited access to structured and profitable markets. The project focuses on strengthening Nyamahasa ACE and its member cooperatives, which specialise in cereals (maize, soybeans, sunflower), as well as cassava and other root crops. SMILE aims to build an inclusive, market-oriented cooperative system that improves production quality, reduces post-harvest losses, and enhances market competitiveness. The project further seeks to increase the participation of women and youth, who face restricted access to finance, land, and decision-making, yet remain central to agricultural production. Expected results include stronger cooperative governance, improved business and financial management, increased adoption of climate-smart agriculture, enhanced market linkages, and greater income stability for smallholders. Core activities comprise governance training, business development support, post-harvest handling improvements, climate-smart extension services, financial literacy, and facilitating access to reliable markets. SMILE ultimately aims to create resilient, profitable, and equitable livelihoods for farming households across the region.
